remarks:
Your Private Country Retreat Awaits! Discover 31.55 acres of beautiful land in the Town of Newstead, offering the highly desirable Clarence Central School District along with the benefit of Newstead’s lower property taxes. This exceptional parcel provides a rare opportunity to create a private estate surrounded by nature, with a wonderful mix of mature woods, open clearings, and natural beauty.
Imagine building the home you’ve always dreamed of, establishing an equestrian property, creating a private hunting retreat, or simply having room to roam and enjoy the outdoors. Trails provide endless opportunities for hiking, exploring, nature watching, and ATV riding. The property’s peaceful setting and privacy make it an ideal place to escape the everyday while still being close to everything you need.
Public water, electric, telephone, cable, and high-speed internet are available at the road, offering excellent potential for future development.
Enjoy the tranquility of country living while remaining conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, golf courses, and other amenities. With easy access to Buffalo, Rochester, and Batavia, this property offers an exceptional combination of privacy, recreation, convenience, and opportunity.
31.55 acres of possibilities—bring your vision and build the private estate, equestrian retreat, or outdoor haven you’ve been dreaming of!
